name: Nura Dev - Voice for AI Coding

ios.desc: Nura Dev turns your iPhone into a voice remote for terminal-based AI coding agents. Pair your CLI in seconds, hold the mic button to speak your prompt, and read the agent's reply on your phone. Stay in the loop wherever you are — kitchen, car, walk, bed — without losing your place in a long-running coding session. WHAT YOU CAN DO • Hold-to-talk voice control — speak naturally, no wake word • Replies in real time — every agent response streamed to your phone as text • Real-time activity feed — see tool calls, file edits, and commands as the agent works • Approve tool calls from your phone — keep dangerous actions safe even when you're away from the keyboard • Persistent chat history — pick up where you left off when you reopen the app • Multi-session support — one app, all your paired coding agent sessions HOW IT WORKS 1. Run your coding agent CLI in your terminal with the Nura plugin installed 2. Scan the pairing QR code from the app 3. Hold the mic, talk, release 4. Read the agent's reply, or tap a tool-call card to approve or deny REQUIRES • A compatible terminal-based AI coding agent and any required subscription • iOS 18 or later • A Google or Apple account for sign-in • A working network connection to your paired terminal session PRIVACY Voice audio is transcribed through Nura's relay and not stored. Your code and conversations stay between your terminal and your iPhone. See nuradev.app/privacy.html for full details. SUBSCRIPTION Nura Dev requires a $4.99/month subscription after a 7-day free trial. Subscriptions auto-renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in Settings → Apple ID → Subscriptions. Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase a subscription. Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/ Privacy Policy: https://nuradev.app/privacy.html
